description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface and filters log output to only include messages, removing metadata like tags or priorities. It is used to streamline log display for readability, particularly in on-screen logs.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters logs to only show messages, enhancing readability for on-screen logs.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that takes the next LogNode to pass filtered logs to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters incoming log message to only pass the message part to the next LogNode, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain where filtered logs are sent.
